component: Scoped browser-test page readiness and separate sync wait

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The test starts a TabOpen listener before submission, then waits for about-addressbook-ready on the new address-book browser. It awaits that combined promise before separate directory-sync completion and tab cleanup. The page dispatches ready after its initial selection/focus work. Tab creation and page readiness are different points; neither alone proves all remote sync complete. Current Enter/focus submission is later than the owned click. No test or intermittent reproduction ran.
title: The account-hub address-book test waits beyond TabOpen before closing its tab
